baskatong_metadata.status: Historical reconstruction not completed: no suitably licensed, aligned 2016–2019 observation pair and no sourced storage curve obtained
baskatong_metadata.next_specific_requirement: Owner-provided boundary-instantaneous reservoir levels at 2016-01-01 00:00 through 2020-01-01 00:00 and matching daily mean total outlet discharge, with explicit timezone/day-label convention, vertical datum, quality flags, Mercier/Castor/spill completeness and permitted local processing. A storage–elevation curve or independently justified usable K is additionally required for volumetric inflow.

baskatong_1970.reference_rule: Normalize reported daily mean levels using the minimum and maximum actually observed in 1970, within the same station datum. Not an operating range or a storage fraction.
baskatong_1970.measurement_timing: Official collection defines daily means. DATE is a calendar date, not a midnight reading or offset-aware instant. Historical daily clock is not established by this API response. UTC is used only as an internal date-axis anchor; timing_verified remains false.
baskatong_1970.discharge_boundary: 02LG006 is officially named GATINEAU (RIVIERE) EN AVAL DU BARRAGE MERCIER. Treat it as downstream Mercier gauge discharge, not a turbine-only series. Total Baskatong outlet completeness and Castor connectivity are unverified. 02LG007 DISCHARGE is retained separately and never assumed interchangeable.
baskatong_1970.vertical_datum: Use the station metadata returned by ECCC; no conversion to modern geodetic operating elevations is inferred.

operating_bounds.interpretation: Modern listed operating elevations; not overlaid on the historical arbitrary station datum

baskatong_1970.volume_mode: No storage curve or K; no volumetric storage or inflow estimates
baskatong_1970.attribution: Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada, HYDAT via MSC GeoMet; contributing agency identified in the saved station metadata.
baskatong_1970.reuse: Wateroffice permits copying/distribution with acknowledgement, excludes resale of bundled raw information and disclaims warranties. No ORRPB observations are accessed.

baskatong_release_scenario.name: Baskatong 1970 approximate linear-storage release scenarios
baskatong_release_scenario.status: Uncalibrated research scenarios; not operational calibration or independent inflow validation

observed_inputs.level_statistic: Published daily mean; historical station datum ARBITRAIRE
observed_inputs.boundary_limit: Neither discharge is established as complete Baskatong outlet flow. No blending or transfer interpretation.

timing_assumption.level_placement: Center of the labelled day, 12:00 on an abstract model calendar; no historical timezone assertion
timing_assumption.interval_discharge: Arithmetic mean of the adjacent labelled daily mean discharges
timing_assumption.missing_context: Leave interval unavailable; no interpolation, fallback, extrapolation or state reset across gaps

linear_storage_assumption.origin_definition: Arbitrary scenario storage origin in the historical station datum; not geological lake volume
linear_storage_assumption.anchor_interpretation: Order-of-magnitude scenario anchor only. NOT verified usable storage or capacity between observed elevations.
linear_storage_assumption.area_derivation: When effective_area_m2 is null: assume K=inventory_anchor_m3*anchor_multiplier over the actual observed 1970 mean-level range, then A_eff=K/range

experimental_bounds_assumed.interpretation: Illustrative constraints in the historical arbitrary datum, not observed extrema or verified operating limits. No modern geodetic limits are applied. Storage bounds derive from these assumed level limits.

source_flags.trajectory_treatment: Use reported flagged values as uncertain inputs for full exploratory trajectories; propagate either adjacent level/discharge flag
source_flags.diagnostics: Also report interval statistics excluding any affected interval. This is not a re-simulated clean trajectory; states may depend on earlier flagged inputs.
source_flags.partial_day: Retain original source label; no correction for unknown coverage hours and no replacement using the other station

prescribed_release_experiment.selection: Use interval-start day-center labels. Reduce reference release subject to declared release minimum. Repay only the retained volume, limited by additional-release rate and declared outlet maximum.
prescribed_release_experiment.information: Prescribed offline experiment with historical proxy schedule as reference; not a forecast or optimized/causal controller
prescribed_release_experiment.bound_handling: Never clip storage. Report violations and mark infeasible. Do not silently repair a historical proxy outside assumed outlet bounds.

baskatong_release_scenario.scope_exclusions: No Ontario changes, Stackelberg optimization, Lake St Louis prediction, routing, reservoir network or RL training

discharge_comparison.scope: 1970 02LG007 versus 02LG006; compare saved official observations without replacing either record

daily_mean_definition.finding: Both API discharge fields belong to the daily-mean collection, whose description defines an average of unit values for a given day. It does not identify the station-specific discharge derivation or historical clock.

partial_day_definition.finding: Current official FAQ grade 30 Partial Day applies to a daily mean containing a missing period longer than 120 consecutive minutes. The daily-symbol explanation also describes daily means estimated despite gaps or missing data not warranting an Estimated symbol. Preserve the API's label; historical hourly coverage and original 1970 flag provenance are not supplied.

station_index.finding: Official name identifies 02LG006 as Gatineau downstream of Mercier dam. Index drainage areas may be rounded relative to saved API metadata.

reservoir_station.finding: Official name places 02LG007 at Baskatong reservoir and lists both level and flow archives; this alone does not establish outlet completeness or whether flow was directly gauged or calculated.

mercier_structure.finding: Mercier is a Baskatong structure; this inventory is not a measurement-method record for either gauge.

castor_structure.finding: Castor is separately registered on Baskatong. Whether it contributed an additional active outlet path in 1970 remains unresolved.

documented_vs_inferred.documented: Saved station names, coordinates, contributors, drainage areas, datum and archived source values/symbols; current official publication definitions.
documented_vs_inferred.derived: Signed daily differences, error summaries and straight-line distance between published coordinates.
documented_vs_inferred.working_judgment: 02LG006 is the better-supported Mercier downstream-flow proxy. Neither record is yet verified as total Baskatong outlet discharge for closed water accounting.
hypotheses_not_established: Different daily averaging clocks or timestamp labels
Real routing, local inflow or additional outlet effects

discharge_comparison.constraints: Do not average the two series, infer a transfer from the difference, rescale Partial Day values by assumed sampling hours, or treat unflagged values as independently validated. Modern station metadata do not prove unchanged 1970 gauge locations or methods. No contact with data owners and no controller modifications.
